title: Expressive
description: A simple plugin that lets you add server-side emotes accessible by the Quick Actions hotkey
body: Expressive is a plugin that allows for players to use emotes without having to install any mods on their client. [](https://modrinth.com/plugin/expressive/gallery) [](https://modrinth.com/plugin/pinelib) [](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bettermodel) ## Setup Setup is as simple as installing the plugin and its dependencies. Expressive handles every step from setting up BetterModel to serving the resource pack on the same port as the server at `/expressive/bettermodel/pack.zip`. ## Configuration There's almost no configuration to do apart from what emotes can be used in `config.yml`. ## Custom Emotes + More There's a bit more to be explored with Expressive but that is detailed in [the docs](https://docs.piny.dev/expressive).
